artifact.name: percent_change_with_direction
artifact.content:
local function roundTo2(n: number): number
	if n >= 0 then
		return math.floor(n * 100 + 0.5) / 100
	else
		return math.ceil(n * 100 - 0.5) / 100
	end
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initial = input.initial_value
	local current = input.current_value

	if initial == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value cannot be zero for percentage change" }
	end

	local delta = current - initial
	local pct = (delta / initial) * 100
	local percentage_change = roundTo2(pct)

	local direction: string
	if current > initial then
		direction = "up"
	elseif current < initial then
		direction = "down"
	else
		direction = "flat"
	end

	return { percentage_change = percentage_change, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Computes percentage change from initial to current, rounded to 2 decimals, with direction up/down/flat.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need a rounded percent change and direction between two numeric values.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local notified: { string } = {}
	local failed: { string } = {}
	local segment = input.segment
	local cutoff = input.inactive_days

	-- List customers in the segment
	local listRes = tools.crm.list({ segment = segment })
	if not listRes.ok then
		return { error = listRes.error, message = listRes.message }
	end

	local customers = listRes.customers
	-- Environment constraint: keep total tool calls reasonable (1 list + up to 10 sends)
	local maxSends = 10
	local sent = 0

	for i, c in customers do
		if c.last_seen_days >= cutoff then
			if sent >= maxSends then
				break
			end
			local text = string.format("Hi %s, we miss you!", c.name)
			local sendRes = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
			if not sendRes.ok then
				table.insert(failed, c.id)
			else
				table.insert(notified, c.id)
				sent += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: Lists a customer segment and messages inactive customers with a friendly reminder.

artifact.content:
local function round2(x: number): number
	local sign = x >= 0 and 1 or -1
	x *= sign
	local r = math.floor(x * 100 + 0.5) / 100
	return r * sign
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initial = input.initial_value
	local current = input.current_value

	if initial == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be 0 for percentage change" }
	end

	local delta = current - initial
	local pct = (delta / initial) * 100
	local pctRounded = round2(pct)

	local dir = "flat"
	if delta > 0 then
		dir = "up"
	elseif delta < 0 then
		dir = "down"
	end

	return { percentage_change = pctRounded, direction = dir }
end
artifact.description: Computes percentage change from initial to current (rounded to 2 decimals) and direction.

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
  -- List customers in the segment
  local listRes = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
  if (listRes :: any).ok ~= true then
    local e = listRes :: ToolError
    return { error = e.error, message = e.message }
  end
  local customers = (listRes :: { ok: true, customers: { CustomerRef } }).customers

  local notified: { string } = {}
  local failed: { string } = {}
  local sentCount = 0

  -- Respect tool call limits: allow up to 10 sends total; 1 call was used for listing
  local maxSends = 10
  local remainingBudget = maxSends - 1
  local sendCap = remainingBudget

  for i = 1, #customers do
    local c = customers[i]
    if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
      if sentCount >= sendCap then
        break
      end
      local text = string.format("Hi %s, we miss you!", c.name)
      local sendRes = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
      if (sendRes :: any).ok == true then
        table.insert(notified, c.id)
        sentCount += 1
      else
        local se = sendRes :: ToolError
        table.insert(failed, c.id)
        sentCount += 1 -- counts attempts that were made
      end
    end
  end

  return {
    notified = notified,
    failed = failed,
    count = #notified,
  }
end

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- List customers in the segment
    local listResult = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
    if listResult.ok == false then
        return { error = listResult.error, message = listResult.message }
    end

    -- Filter eligible customers: last_seen_days >= inactive_days
    local eligible: { CustomerRef } = {}
    for i = 1, #listResult.customers do
        local c = listResult.customers[i]
        if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
            eligible[#eligible + 1] = c
        end
    end

    -- Prepare results
    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}

    -- Respect execution constraints: 1 list call already used; allow up to 10 sends
    local maxSends = 10
    local sendsDone = 0
    for i = 1, #eligible do
        local c = eligible[i]
        if sendsDone < maxSends then
            local text = string.format("Hi %s, we miss you!", c.name)
            local sendResult = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
            if sendResult.ok == false then
                failed[#failed + 1] = c.id
            else
                notified[#notified + 1] = c.id
            end
            sendsDone += 1
        else
            -- Could not send due to tool call budget; mark as failed
            failed[#failed + 1] = c.id
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
